name: gstack-execution
description: Software development execution engine adapted from Garry Tan's gstack (MIT). Code review, adversarial just-committed review (real Codex or Claude fallback), security audit, debugging, QA testing, and shipping — the ship pipeline validates in a disposable worktree with a safe-fix/escalate contract (concept-ported from no-mistakes, MIT). Pairs with Product Orchestrator for the full decide-then-build loop. Browser testing via Claude in Chrome. Carries a verification-discipline contract: claims are verified through the user's own path, or the report says which part was not, and a SessionStart hook injects those checks so they arrive without the skill being invoked.
